evidence.quote: The immutable quote token is trusted canonical six-decimal USDC with standard, non-rebasing, fee-free transfers. Supported prizes are honest, standards-compliant ERC-721s.

evidence.role: Prize admission relies on the arbitrary contract's ERC-165 self-report.
Escrow verification relies on behavior and ownership reported by the same prize contract.
NFT-result settlement creates releasable quote liabilities before prize delivery.
Sponsor proceeds can be released without a successful-prize-delivery gate.
Winner delivery again trusts arbitrary prize behavior and its owner report.

searched.result: Read DESIGN.md, all five production files, and all 31 manifest-listed dependencies in full; 31/31 dependency SHA-256 values matched.
31 production hits and 0 dependency hits; honest has 1 hit at IRaffle.sol:L14-L15, while untrusted has 0.
1 production supportsInterface check, 3 prize transfer calls, and 3 prize owner-report calls.
External entrypoint searches found only implementation/interface declarations; 10 production entrypoints apply nonReentrant, and OpenZeppelin receiver and guard implementations were traced in full.

reasoning: Trusted dependencies are fixed, wrapper callbacks are authenticated, and ticket-recipient callbacks plus transaction-local prize reverts/reentry receive meaningful containment. However, the NftWon branch can settle and release quote proceeds before prize delivery, while escrow and delivery rely on self-reported behavior from the arbitrary prize contract. Cash/refund and recipient paths still satisfy the boundary, so partial is more accurate than implemented or wholly contradicted.
